name: toolsmith-example
description: Worked example for tools/toolsmith — a real, verified inline_deno tool. Not registered with Core and not shipped; it exists so the scaffold → verify pipeline has an end-to-end regression test.

config.description: Split a string into fixed-size chunks with optional overlap, returning each chunk with its start offset.

overlap.description: Characters each chunk re-reads from the previous one. Must be less than size. Defaults to 0.
